data.name: Eula
data.gender_notes: Eula is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Eula was the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. Her name comes from the Greek word eu, meaning 'good' or 'bright'. In Christianity, Eula is not a commonly used name, but it can be considered a variant of the name Euphrosyne, which means 'joy' or 'delight'. The name Eula carries the meaning “Bright, radiant one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eula usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, radiant one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Eula belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright, radiant one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eula total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_greek.name: Εὐλα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Εὐλα προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη που σημαίνει 'καλή διάθεση', 'χαρά', ή 'εὐγένεια'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόλο που δεν αναφέρεται άμεσα, οι ιδιότητες αυτές συνδέονται με την πνευματική χαρά και την καλοσύνη που αναζητούν οι πιστοί. Το όνομα Εὐλα αντανακλά την πνευματική και ηθική αρτιότητα που εκτιμάται στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας.
